```{=html}
<div class="poly-page" hidden></div>
<script src="/apps/shared/polyrhythm.js?v=1"></script>
<style>
.poly{border:1px solid var(--bs-border-color);border-radius:.5rem;padding:.75rem;margin:1rem 0;background:var(--bs-body-bg)}
.poly-bar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.75rem;align-items:center;margin-bottom:.5rem}
.poly-tempo input{vertical-align:middle;width:9rem}
.poly-preset{width:auto;max-width:100%}
.poly-view{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(140px,220px) 1fr;gap:1rem;align-items:center}
@media (max-width:600px){.poly-view{grid-template-columns:1fr}.poly-circle{max-width:220px;margin:auto}}
.poly-circle{width:100%;height:auto;color:var(--bs-secondary-color)}
.poly-ring{fill:none;stroke:var(--bs-border-color);stroke-width:1}
.poly-dot{transition:r .08s}
.poly-dot.lit{stroke:var(--bs-body-color);stroke-width:2.5}
.poly-hand{stroke:var(--bs-body-color);stroke-width:1.5;opacity:.6}
.poly-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;margin:.35rem 0}
.poly-label{flex:0 0 8.5rem;text-align:left;font-size:.8rem;background:none;border:0;border-left:4px solid;padding:.1rem .4rem;color:inherit}
.poly-label small{color:var(--bs-secondary-color)}
.poly-cells{display:flex;flex:1;gap:2px;height:1.6rem}
.poly-cell{border-radius:3px;background:var(--bs-tertiary-bg);opacity:.9}
.poly-cell.on{opacity:.55}.poly-cell.acc{opacity:.85}
.poly-cell.rep{box-shadow:inset 2px 0 0 var(--bs-body-color)}
.poly-cell.lit{opacity:1;outline:2px solid var(--bs-body-color)}
.poly-muted{opacity:.3}
.poly-ratio{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--bs-secondary-color);margin:.5rem 0 0}
.poly-edit{margin-top:.75rem;border-top:1px solid var(--bs-border-color);padding-top:.5rem}
.poly-erow{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.5rem;align-items:center;margin:.3rem 0}
.poly-erow .poly-src{width:14rem;font-family:monospace}.poly-erow select{width:auto}
.poly-sw{width:.9rem;height:.9rem;border-radius:50%;display:inline-block}
h2.poly-fold{cursor:pointer}
h2.poly-fold::before{content:"▾ ";font-size:.8em;color:var(--bs-secondary-color)}
section.poly-closed > h2.poly-fold::before{content:"▸ "}
section.poly-closed > :not(h2){display:none}
</style>
```
